name: Popup / Overlay
summary: Marketing dialog surface with overlay, content, optional media, Close Button composition, and default, split, or slide presentation.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Backdrop and centered containment layer for popup presentation.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Optional named native dismiss button that follows Close Button obligations.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible popup title and preferred dialog label source.

variants.name: split
variants.description: Two-column media and content surface that collapses to one column on narrow viewports.

states.name: overlayHidden
states.description: Overlay is visually hidden by default.

states.name: slideHidden
states.description: Slide presentation is translated below the viewport by default.

states.name: closeHover
states.description: Pointer hover on the optional dismiss action.

states.name: closeFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the optional dismiss action.

behavior.name: visibilitySurface
behavior.description: Canonical CSS currently recognizes data-open on the overlay and on the slide surface; the contract does not select a single public open-property surface while that ownership remains unresolved.

behavior.name: dialogSemantics
behavior.description: Modal popup use requires a programmatically named dialog. Non-modal use requires an explicit target decision rather than silently reusing modal semantics.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: The consuming target moves focus into a modal popup, contains tab navigation, and restores focus to its trigger after dismissal.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: A modal popup provides a visible dismiss action and Escape dismissal; Close Button composition owns native button activation while the popup target owns visibility and focus restoration.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Canonical default, split, or slide presentation.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible popup title used to name the dialog.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Optional native button that requests popup dismissal.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual accessible name for the optional dismiss button.

accessibility: Use role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" for modal popup use and name it from the visible title.
Move focus into a modal popup when it opens, contain focus while open, and restore focus to the trigger when it closes.
Provide a visible named dismiss action and support Escape dismissal.
Do not add an email field API until popup email-capture ownership is accepted; any composed field must independently satisfy Input obligations.
Respect reduced-motion preferences for overlay and slide transitions.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/marketing.css; runtime dialog behavior remains target-owned.
